{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(data))
print("Unique patient_id:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_stats = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts()
print("Max sample_seq per patient:")
print(sample_seq_stats)"}
